simple.meaning: נָדִיב (nâdîyb) appears 29 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with priesthood. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Numbers, 1 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, and 5 more, beginning at Exodus 35:5. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as offering, sacrifice, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָדִיב (H5081) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows נָדִיב through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: נָדִיב (nâdîyb) / H5081 is tracked through Exodus 35:5, Exodus 35:22, Numbers 21:18, 1 Samuel 2:8. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H5081. nadib נָדִיב adjective and noun masculine Isa 32:8 inclined, Generous, noble ; — absolute ׳נ 32:5-6 t.; construct נְדִיב Exod 35:5 2 t.; feminine נְדִיבָה Psa 51:4 ; plural נְדִיבִים Isa 13:2 9 t.; construct נְדִיבֵי Num 21:18 2 t.; suffix נְדִיבֵמוֺ Psa 83:12 ; — 1 incited, inclined, willing , לֵב נְדִיב Exod 35:5 , 22 (P), 1 Chronicles 29:31 (see נָדַב Qal ), בְחָכְמָה נָדִיב 1Chr 28:21 ; נְדִיבָה רוּחַ Psa 51:14 a willing spirit. 2 noble, princely , in rank 1Sam 2:8 (poem), Job 12:21 = Psa 107:40 ; Job 34:18 ; Prov 8:16 ; Psalm 47:10; Psa 83:12 ; 113:8 (twice in verse); 118:9 ; 146:3 ; נדיב מְּנֵי Prov 19:6 ; 25:7 ; נ ׳בית Job 21:28 ; נ ׳פתחי Isa 13:2 ; נ ׳בת Cant 7:2; הָעָם נְדִיבֵי Num 21:18 (poem). 3 noble in mind and character || צדּיק Prov 17:26 ; opposed to נָבָל Isa 32:5 , 8 .
